description: Karta potresne nevarnosti is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. Earthquake hazard map of Slovenia. Projected ground acceleration for a return period of 475 years. Coverage: AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. The portal shows the English title as "Earthquake hazard map" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA OKOLJE. Its keywords include potresna nevarnost, Slovenija, potres, Območja nevarnosti naravnih nesreč. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
